modules.alt: General dentistry at My Dear Dentistry

modules.html:
Advanced care for a lifetime of healthy teeth

Great dental care supports more than your smile; it supports your overall wellness. As trusted Montrose General Dentists, we take a whole-body approach to oral health, providing advanced care with a personal touch.

Families from Montrose, West University, Boulevard Oaks, and Southampton trust us with their exams, cleanings, fillings, and crowns, and we welcome patients from every one of the neighborhoods we serve. At My Dear Dentist, you’ll enjoy consistent, comfortable visits and personalized treatment designed to keep you smiling and thriving for life.

New to My Dear Dentist? We have something just for you

We’ve created a couple of special offers to help you start (or continue) your care with confidence.

Your first visit includes a comprehensive exam, digital X-rays, and a routine cleaning — so we can get a clear picture of your oral and whole-body health.

For new, non-insured patients.

New to My Dear Dentist?
We have a little something just for you

Take advantage of our $99 new patient special, designed to help you start your smile journey with ease. Your visit includes a comprehensive exam, routine cleaning, and our curated new patient welcome package — thoughtfully designed to support your whole-body health at home.

It’s our way of saying: Welcome. We’re so glad you’re here.
Comprehensive care for every age & every smile

items.title: Family Dentistry
items.html: Comprehensive dental care for kids, teens, adults, and seniors — personalized for every smile in your family.

items.title: Sealants
items.html: A simple, painless treatment that protects teeth from cavities, especially helpful for kids and teens.

items.title: Bridges
items.html: Bridges replace missing teeth with secure, natural-looking restorations that restore bite, function, and appearance.

items.title: Bonding
items.html: Quickly correct chips, gaps, or discoloration with bonding, an affordable way to enhance your smile.

items.title: Dental Implants
items.html: Permanent, natural-looking tooth replacement that restores full function and brings back your confident smile.

items.title: Dentures
items.html: Comfortable, well-fitting dentures restore missing teeth so you can eat, speak, and smile with ease.
